problems: The active official homepage has strong proof content but repeats generic claims and testimonial blocks without a concise first-step scheduling path.
The primary action is presented as 'Book Now' in English amid Portuguese content, creating a trust and completion-friction signal for a local clinic.
Visible counter content renders as zero values (for example 0+), undermining otherwise strong trust signals around experience, team and positive reviews.
Treatments, structure, testimonials, FAQ and contact are spread over a very long page; mobile users must traverse substantial content before reaching location and contact details.
rebuild_angle: Make the clinic's calm, human care and modern consultório proof legible in one appointment journey, preserving the Batel location and existing patient-confidence language.
concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Oralclin because it turns the clinic's published promise of a healthy smile, attentive care, modern equipment, child-friendly experience and patient testimony into a quiet appointment journey rather than a generic dental-service grid.
concept_rules: Compose the page as a guided appointment journey from reassurance to treatments to visit, using a curved 'care path' rather than a card grid.
Preserve the Oralclin logo and verified blue/teal visual cues; use a warm clinical white and one coral appointment accent sparingly.
Pair a soft contemporary serif for patient-facing reassurance with a high-legibility sans for treatments, reviews and contact details.
Use official clinic/space imagery as cropped windows with generous white space; never fabricate before/after treatment outcomes.
Replace every generic action with one clear local-language conversion path to the official contact route; retain only verified phone/email details.
On mobile, surface the appointment action, patient reassurance, location and hours early; keep testimonials as short editorial proof rather than an endless stack.
active_evidence: Official homepage returned HTTP 200 and rendered on 2026-07-18; page publishes Batel address, phone/email, weekday hours, treatments, 4.9/5.0 review proof and a new consultório section.
